text:
Ana: quick accessibility sweep of the top toolbar and global shortcuts. Found a couple odd behaviors with the skiplink, toolbar icon focus, and VoiceOver announcing collapsed states twice. Dropping notes.
Luis: thanks Ana. TL;DR bullets pls so eng can triage.
Ana: TL;DR: 1) "Skip to toolbar" link gets removed from tab order after first activation (we recreate it during animation), 2) icon-only toolbar buttons lose focus ring in dark mode, 3) VoiceOver announces "collapsed" and then announces the label again for the overflow menu, 4) global shortcut `g t` conflicts with editor plugin when the terminal modal is open.
Priya: good. can you paste repro + tiny fixes?
Ana: repro skiplink: Console page load, Tab once -> skip shows "Skip to toolbar" -> activate -> focus jumps to toolbar and we run an enter animation that removes the original element and inserts a new one. Second time Tab, the skip link isn't reachable. Fix: keep the skiplink node stable, toggle `.visually-hidden` and keep `tabindex=0`. Add `aria-controls="global-toolbar"` and `aria-expanded` when toolbar is shown.
Luis: agree. also set `data-skip-id` to avoid accidental rehydration. For animation keep `pointer-events:none` instead of removing node.
Ana: VoiceOver oddness: overflow menu button is `<button aria-expanded="false">More</button>` and the menu panel uses `role="menu"` but we also add `aria-hidden` to panel while animating in. VO reads "More collapsed" then reads the visible label again. Proposed: set `aria-haspopup="true" aria-controls="overflow-menu"` and only toggle `aria-expanded` at the same moment the panel becomes focusable. Use `aria-atomic="true"` on the panel.
Sam: for the double-read, ensure we don't change visible text and programmatic attributes at different frames. Batch DOM attribute changes inside a single RAF tick: `requestAnimationFrame(()=>{ button.setAttribute(...); panel.classList.remove('hidden'); })`.
Priya: toolbar icon focus: which selectors?
Ana: `.toolbar .icon-btn:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(11,102,255,0.92); }` but in dark theme the box-shadow blends with overlay because we set low alpha. Quick CSS: use solid outline on focus-visible and ensure `:focus:not(:focus-visible)` doesn't show it. Example: ```css .icon-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #0b66ff; outline-offset: 2px; }```
Luis: include prefers-contrast and prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks.
Ana: shortcut collision: global handler listens for `g` then `t` open tool switcher. Problem: when the in-page editor modal is focused it uses `g` for goto-line. Suggest scoping: only run global shortcuts when `document.activeElement` is body or when `document.querySelector('#global-toolbar'):contains(document.activeElement)` is false. Or use library scoping: `Mousetrap.bindGlobal('g t', openToolSwitcher, {scope: 'global'})` and set scope on modal open.
Sam: testing plan: add e2e keyboard test that opens editor modal and asserts `g t` doesn't trigger toolbar. Also add a VO smoke test: open overflow -> press Esc -> ensure focus returns to trigger.
accessibility-bot: auto-audit: https://redwood-infra/audits/2249009999 — Contrast: PASS overall but WARN on icon focus in dark mode; Focus-visible: FAIL (icon-btns), ARIA: WARN (overflow panel aria-hidden toggled mid-animation), Shortcuts: WARN (global shortcuts not scoped).
Priya: prioritization: 1) keep skiplink node stable + aria-controls (low) 2) fix icon focus-visible (low) 3) batch aria-expanded/aria-hidden changes for overflow to avoid VO double reads (medium) 4) scope keyboard shortcuts (medium).
Luis: I'll open a small PR for 1+2 with CSS and a tiny unit test today. Sam: can you pair on 3 for animation batching?
Sam: yes. I'll also run VoiceOver/NVDA passes after the PR and add the e2e keyboard test.
Ana: thanks all, linking to the design card and screenshots: https://redwood-infra/board/899 and will include before/after color tokens. :white_check_mark:
